1.web: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
1.asv: Now these were the sons of David, that were born unto him in Hebron: the first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

2.web: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
2.asv: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

3.web: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
3.asv: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

4.web: six were born to him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. In Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years;
4.asv: six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years;

5.web: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
5.asv: and these were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;

6.web: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
6.asv: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

7.web: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
7.asv: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

8.web: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
8.asv: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

9.web: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
9.asv: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

10.web: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
10.asv: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

11.web: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
11.asv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

12.web: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
12.asv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

13.web: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
13.asv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

14.web: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
14.asv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

15.web: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
15.asv: And the sons of Josiah: the first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

16.web: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
16.asv: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

17.web: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
17.asv: And the sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

18.web: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
18.asv: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

19.web: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
19.asv: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

20.web: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab Hesed, five.
20.asv: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

21.web: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
21.asv: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

22.web: The sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
22.asv: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

23.web: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
23.asv: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

24.web: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
24.asv: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
